import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

const FILE = "todos.json";
const todos = JSON.parse(readFileSync(FILE, "utf8"));
const [cmd, ...rest] = process.argv.slice(2);

switch (cmd) {
  case "add":

    writeFileSync(FILE, JSON.stringify(todos, null, 2));
    break;
  case "done":
    todos[Number(rest[0])].done = true;
    writeFileSync(FILE, JSON.stringify(todos, null, 2));
    break;
  case "list":
    todos.forEach((t, i) => console.log(`${i}. [${t.done ? "x" : " "}] ${t.text}`));
    break;
  default:
    console.log("usage: todo <add|done|list>");
}
